No new verbal box, stem, sense or fabricated person ending is published from this low-confidence token. The birth-date formula remains documented for editorial/recording review.
The inherited source note and terminology remain verbatim within the existing gloss; this job does not silently normalise it or merge wld and wlḏ.
In the 104/1 recording, is tawalləd a finite borrowed verb, a reduced participial expression, or a birth-date nominal formula? Confirm its full vocalism and person reference.
